description: Per-axis grade history for TOURney platform. Updated automatically by review skills. Operations Action Board reads this file.

scores.notes: is_admin column dropped (migration 006) — dual-source gap from May 6 resolved. Clean init layer, sensible MPA routing, 11 versioned migrations. tournament_admins email-based (migration 004). Settings key-value store flexible but un-typed remains the only gap.

Clean init layer, sensible MPA routing, good migration hygiene. Main gap: dual is_admin source-of-truth (players.is_admin column vs tournament_admins table). Settings key-value store is flexible but un-typed.

Three tournament structures, 12 scoring formats, realtime scorecard with match tracker, HIO confetti, feed, directory, champions, admin Design tab with 24 settings keys. Gaps: no tournament series, no score admin-edit UI, test scores missing for weekend-scramble-test and four-team-test.
Three tournament structures (individual/team/pairs), 12 scoring formats, multi-day support, PWA install. Gap: round naming hardcoded day1/2/3, no tournament series concept, no score admin-edit UI.

user-scalable=no on scorecard WCAG 1.4.4 fail; no loading skeletons site-wide (blank flash); raw Supabase error?.message in login.html; no prefers-reduced-motion on home.html animations. Strengths: CSS token usage consistent across 25+ pages, player.html ARIA exemplary, login.html multi-mode UX solid, scoreboard empty-state pattern correct.

Consistent dark gold design system, mobile hamburger all pages, PWA install, HIO confetti overlay, competitive/casual mode badge. Gaps: no loading skeletons (blank-flash on all pages), empty states partial, accessibility not audited.
Consistent dark gold design system, mobile hamburger on all pages. Empty states partially implemented. No loading skeletons — pages blank-flash while fetching. Accessibility not audited.

Vercel static deploy, full security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame, X-Content-Type, Referrer-Policy), SW v17 with correct JSON bypass. /platform ops hub self-documents the platform. Two git remotes (bova-invt + TOURney mirror). Gaps: no CI/CD, no staging, edge functions require manual SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN deploy.

Vercel static deploy, clean routing, PWA with service worker. Security headers in vercel.json (HSTS, X-Frame, X-Content-Type). Manual test suite (test.js, 7 checks). Gap: no CI/CD, no Sentry, no analytics, no staging environment.

SW v17 cache-first assets, network-first HTML, JSON bypass. Supabase realtime on scorecard (low-latency scores). DB indexes on tournament_id, player_id. No loading skeletons — blank-flash on all pages. Scorecard polls every 3s as fallback. No performance monitoring or alerts.

admin.html 151KB, home.html 144KB — heavy inline JS per page (no bundler). External deps: Supabase CDN, Google Fonts. SW precache covers critical path. No image optimization pipeline. Most pages use Promise.all for parallel DB queries.

11 migrations, full audit trail. is_admin column dropped (006). tournament_admins email-based (004). Indexes on tournament_id + player_id. Billing columns in tournaments table (002). push_subscriptions + trash_talk scoped (010, 011). Remaining gap: settings store un-typed, player_accounts anon read policy still open.

5 migrations with clean progression. tournament_admins now canonical (is_admin column being deprecated). Settings key-value store flexible but un-typed. RLS gaps: player_accounts and invitations policies too permissive. No created_at/updated_at on all tables.

Premium brand, clear pricing, embedded live demo, strong H1. Critical gaps: no OG/Twitter card meta tags (zero social unfurl), zero social proof/testimonials, PWA install differentiator not headlined. Top 3 actions: add OG tags, add Bova social proof callout, rewrite meta description to benefit-first.

Invite code gate kills cold-traffic conversion. login.html signup requires pre-existing RSVP (conversion bug). PWA install orphaned from player journey. Key wins: fix signup error message, add request-access to invite gate, surface PWA install post-RSVP.

Stripe wiring B+ (edge functions, webhook, DB schema built, no hardcoded keys). Zero revenue — LLC not formed, no live Stripe keys, reg_open=false, no ToS/Privacy. Operating costs ~$57/mo (Anthropic dominant). Breakeven ~30 pro players at $2/mo. Three actions: form LLC, wire Stripe in test mode, open accounting + flip reg_open.
